user.title: Set up HASS Energy
user.description: Pick the Nord Pool prices to plan with.

data_description.nordpool_entry: The Nord Pool integration that provides the prices.
data_description.nordpool_area: One of the areas set up in that Nord Pool integration.

sensors.title: Inverter and battery
sensors.description: All optional. Past periods come from the lifetime energy totals where they're set, and from the power sensors otherwise; the values now come from the power sensors. The battery and prices are what the battery is planned with.

data_description.battery_soc: The battery's state of charge in %.
data_description.battery_discharge_power: Power coming out of the battery.

data_description.grid_power: Power drawn from the grid. A meter that goes negative while exporting can be set here alone, with no grid export power.
data_description.grid_export_power: Power sent to the grid, if the measured power above doesn't go negative for it.

data_description.battery_output_energy: Ever-increasing kWh out of the battery.
data_description.solar_energy: Ever-increasing kWh from the solar panels.
data_description.grid_import_energy: Ever-increasing kWh drawn from the grid.
data_description.grid_export_energy: Ever-increasing kWh sent to the grid.

data_description.battery_capacity: How much energy the battery holds when full. The battery is only planned once this and both maximum powers are set.
data_description.battery_min_soc: The plan never takes the battery below this. 10 % when not set.
data_description.battery_max_soc: The plan never charges the battery above this. 100 % when not set.
data_description.battery_max_charge: The most power the battery takes in.
data_description.battery_max_discharge: The most power the battery gives out.
data_description.battery_efficiency: The share of the energy put in that comes back out. 90 % when not set.
data_description.battery_wear_cost: What wearing the battery costs per kWh charged, in the Nord Pool currency, so it isn't cycled for tiny savings. 0 when not set.

data_description.import_fee: Added to the spot price for each kWh bought, before VAT: the supplier's markup, the grid fee and energy tax, in the Nord Pool currency. 0 when not set.
data_description.vat: VAT on bought energy. 25 % when not set.
data_description.export_compensation: Added to the spot price for each kWh sold, in the Nord Pool currency (negative for a fee). 0 when not set.

abort.single_instance_allowed: HASS Energy is already set up.
abort.nordpool_missing: Set up the Nord Pool integration first.

error.area_not_in_entry: This area isn't set up in the chosen Nord Pool integration.
error.battery_incomplete: Set the battery's capacity and both maximum powers, or none of them: the battery is only planned with all three.
error.soc_range: The battery's lowest charge must be below its highest.
